results.note: This test (and test_stochrsi_note_maps_talib_fastd_to_tradingview_k, line 40) reads definition.parameters/.note from load_registry()'s parsed IndicatorDefinition objects, not registry.yaml text. The diff deletes the old flawed tests in test_differential.py that did REGISTRY_PATH.read_text() substring search for the exact strings that also appear as comments on registry.yaml lines 6-7 — the trap the criterion names.

registered_definition() and all differential tests pull parameters via load_registry().root[...].parameters (parsed pydantic fields), then pass them into both the oracle and the actual macd()/stochrsi() calls — never reading registry.yaml as text.
Both oracles use patch.object(talib, "MACD"/"STOCHRSI"/"RSI", wraps=...) and assert call_count == 0, a real spy on the TA-Lib function itself rather than trusting pandas-ta's talib=False flag.
Forces talib_enabled=True for both MACD and StochRSI oracles and asserts pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="oracle delegated to TA-Lib") — the guard is shown to actually fire, not merely exist.

Both tests fetch registry parameters via registered_definition(), compare only the CONVERGED_TAIL_LENGTH=32 converged tail (after warm-up on a 500-bar series), and pass registry parameters into both the oracle call and the actual macd()/stochrsi() calls.

tests/goldens/btc_macd.json and tests/goldens/btc_stochrsi.json exist and RESPONSE_MODELS in ingest/canary.py:19-21 now includes btc_macd and btc_stochrsi both mapped to OkxCandleResponse; this integration-style test runs assert_registry_coverage against the real load_registry(), the on-disk goldens, and the real RESPONSE_MODELS dict, which is exactly the PRD-002 invariant applied without special-casing the new entries.
Deterministic gate 'US-411-C7' (uv run pytest -q --no-header -o addopts=) exit code 0, confirmed alongside the typecheck and test gates both exiting 0.

note: Verified against the live repo files (not just the diff): ingest/registry.yaml, ingest/registry.py, ingest/indicators.py, ingest/canary.py, tests/test_differential.py, tests/test_macd_stochrsi.py, tests/test_macd_stochrsi_registry.py, tests/test_coverage.py, tests/test_goldens.py all read as claimed. All three research traps from 10-research.md are concretely addressed: the TA-Lib spy (not talib=False) rejects delegation for both MACD and StochRSI with a demonstrated-to-bite test, STOCHRSI parameters in registry.yaml are timeperiod=14/fastk_period=14 with an explicit note that TA-Lib's fastd is TradingView's K, and MACD required_bars=250 is enforced by registry.py's RECURSIVE_TALIB_FUNCTIONS set. No assertion-free tests or comment-satisfied criteria found; the two goldens carry real 250-bar input vectors and honest provenance strings.
